title: Vertical federated learning system optimization method, device, equipment and readable storage medium

pse.problem: Inefficiency in utilizing a model trained through vertical federated learning when participants require cooperation with each other to make predictions for new customers due to missing data.
pse.solution_function: Trains an interpolation model using first sample data from a first device and second sample data from a second device, which are aligned during the optimization process. The interpolation model is used to predict data characteristics of the first device based on data characteristics of the second device.
pse.solution_structure: Includes a first device for collecting first sample data and a second device for collecting second sample data. Also includes an interpolation model that serves as the key component coordinating the interaction between the first and second devices.
pse.solution_implementation: Performs sample alignment between the first and second devices, then uses the aligned first sample data to train the interpolation model cooperatively with the second device. The trained interpolation model can take data from the first device as input and output corresponding data for the second device.
pse.effect: Allows participants of a vertical federated learning system to utilize the trained model independently, reducing the need for communication and cooperation between participants for making predictions.
